source.locator: Pin drawing/Table 10 p9; p10 backup state; Tables 12-14 pp11-12; startup p13

absolute_limits.rf_input_power_condition: 50 ohm continuous-wave source, not LTE coexistence performance

integration_requirements: Do not drive PIOs with VCC and V_IO absent in hardware backup mode.
Supply must deliver up to 100 mA startup current; indicative steady-state currents are typical, not guaranteed maxima.
The existing model is an open-VIO_SEL subset. A grounded-VIO_SEL 1800 mV mode needs a separate explicit model.
Pin 15 remains unconnected in the open-selector subset; pin 14 is not passive antenna bias.
Verify V_IO supply ramp, relative V_IO/VCC limits, transient margins and actual receiver gain configuration.
Integrated LNA/SAW/DC block and low-gain default do not establish antenna matching, ESD immunity or simultaneous cellular coexistence.
